correctness.rationale: For all integer n>=5, the nine numerator and five denominator exponents are separately distinct. Exact symbolic multiplication of (x^n+x+1)Q_n gives coefficients 3,2,2 in the central band, which at x=3 carry to x^(n+3); hence P_n(3)=(3^n+4)Q_n(3). Polynomial divisibility Q_n|P_n would imply 5|9 at x=1, impossible. x^n+x+1 evaluated at 3 gives the trivial universal representation. The standalone verifier reproduces exact identities for 200 n-values; no finite-to-infinite inference is made.

value.rationale: The 2023 paper explicitly seeks a classification of universal versus local ternary quotient types. Its only-universal theorem for 3^n+1 contrasts sharply with the immediately next value of the same admissible residue class, 3^n+4, whose local type is now proved for all n>=5. Uniform bounds of five and nine nonzero ternary digits prevent the witness from becoming combinatorially large as n increases. This gives a genuine infinite structural family beyond the source finite catalog, though not a full classification or optimal sparsity theorem.
